high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Supriya Sahu IAS (@supriyasahuias) posted 3 hours ago. The tweet describes a heartwarming scene where a family of elephants is crossing a railway track at Madukkarai in Coimbatore. The AI-powered early warning system by the Tamil Nadu Forest Department ensures their safe passage. The tweet includes a black-and-white video thumbnail showing two elephants crossing a railway track. The elephants appear to be moving slowly and deliberately, indicating they are likely part of a herd.
